resolution: Generation 1 is accepted only for the read-only target-host-profile repository component. The deterministic allow-listed collector preserves failed or absent observations as UNKNOWN, rejects custom generation-1 probe surfaces, and does not infer physical-host or completion credit. No execution on the intended physical target host has been observed in this acceptance.
next_exact_action: Obtain one read-only physical target fingerprint bundle on the actual intended host and admit its exact profile generation/digest; collection alone must not be promoted to whole-host completion.
